test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **tend**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Tend:** to usually do or be something. (प्रायः कुछ करना या होना, प्रवृत्ति या झुकाव होना) • **Example:** There ***tends ***to be a lot of heavy traffic on that road. • The sentence implies that we usually set unrealistic goals because we are so desperate for perfection. • Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 3 is **option 2**. Correct Paragraph:__ *We believe our value is in direct proportion to the value of our accomplishments. If we cannot accomplish certain results, we tend to feel (1) __low__ about ourselves. Some of us try too hard and become workaholics and over-achievers. With a few genuine feelings of self-worth, we try to create some and prove that we are somebody by our successes and (2) __achievements__. Because our desire for perfection is so great, we **(3) __tend__** to set unrealistic goals and place unreasonable demands on ourselves. Failing, rather than encouraging us to have realistic aspirations, only leads to a mere punishing round of self-blame and a resolve to drive ourselves harder next time. If we do not finally achieve our goals, we are (4) ______; despite everything we have done, we still feel (5) ______ inside.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Come: **to arrive somewhere or reach a particular place or time. ((कहीं और किसी समय) पहुँचना, आ जाना) • **Wish: **to want something that cannot now happen or that probably will not happen. (किसी वस्‍तु की चाह रखना) • **Crave: **to want and need to have something very much. (किसी वस्‍तु के लिए अत्‍यधिक लालायित होना, ज़ोरदार तलब उठना; तरसना) 1cb:T1013, The correct answer is **disappointed.**
